# Poly — The Many Notations

## #0 — Inventory offices rather than synonyms

The input is the actual field of notations developed by the [Binary Explication](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md) and curated in the [core spine](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md). Poly is their real plurality within [Mono's](mono.md) common subject. Each sign must retain the signature that gives it its work.

## #1 — Separate the native address systems

| Notation | Office | Required context |
|---|---|---|
| `0,1` and `00,01,10,11` | Terms and ordered binary pairings | Single versus paired levels |
| `0/1`, `1/0`, `(0/1)/(1/0)` | Oriented and self-related native relation | Native slash versus arithmetic quotient |
| `−/− … 1/0` | Eight-turn determination traversal | Six-position body within two thresholds |
| `#0 … #5` | Position addresses | Qualitative, processual or nested table named |
| `4:2`, `3:3` | Structural and dynamic readings | Subject-first 3:3 remains active with 3:1 |
| Primed addresses | Inverse phase or Night pass | File 2 and File 3 explicitly distinguished |

A repeated glyph can therefore change office without changing its printed shape. The [eight-determinations table](../ql/eight-determinations.md) shows why qualitative `?/!` at #1 cannot simply replace processual `?/!` at #3.

## #2 — Retain the musical dialects

The music field adds pure ratios, pitch classes, chromatic/fifths generators, families, lens anchors and scale grammar. `9/8` is an exact ratio; a two-semitone step in 12TET has ratio `2^(2/12)`. Their pitch-class association does not make the frequencies equal.

Likewise the same position-index receives different pitch-class addresses under the chromatic and fifths maps. [Chromatic substrates](../music/chromatic-substrates.md) supplies their generators and same-position conjugate flips. The notation's role determines whether a numerical difference means a positional step, a semitone displacement or an interval ratio.

## #3 — Work a shared result through distinct descriptions

The number 6 can be the count `2+2²`, the perfect number with proper divisors 1,2,3, or the number of pitch classes in one whole-tone orbit. Each equality is exact under its construction. Their co-occurrence becomes a correspondence only when the page states what is mapped.

For example, counting six positions and counting six orbit members establishes equal cardinality. A chosen bijection can then label the positions by those pitches. Preservation of adjacency, inverse relations or ratio structure requires further checks. Equal cardinality alone does not supply them.

## #4 — Preserve plurality under common use

[Translations](translations.md) distinguishes derivation, construction and argued recognition. This allows one field to carry mathematical, musical and psychic exactness without appointing a preferred notation to erase their differences. A psychic `X/x` refraction, a real-variable equation and a pitch variation do not have identical proof conditions.

The four-file locks give another concrete distinction: definition/quilt carry the short return, process/music the full inverse circuit. The inventory records both. It does not add a ninth determination or identify the eight-turn traversal with every structure in QL.

## #5→0 — Make each notation retrievable

The result is a usable plurality: a reader can ask what a sign does, which rule licenses it, and which source-local office it occupies. A translation can preserve one relation while leaving another unexpressed; the excluded relation remains available for return.

This record returns-to [A12](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md), [C50](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C50-Dia-Syn.md), and [Syn](../dia-syn/syn.md). The many are actual articulations of the whole, and their differences are material to its legibility.
